issues.detail: The route visibly checks CanRead(unit.TypeIssues), not CanWrite, but the answer stops before the persistence call and therefore cannot establish the final read-only creation effect.
It correctly identifies repository/poster binding and write-only metadata branches, but leaves reqToken, repository assignment, admin semantics, and persistence unexamined.

sourceSupport.detail: POST uses reqToken(), mustNotBeArchived, binding, reqRepoReader(unit.TypeIssues), then CreateIssue.
reqRepoReader tests CanRead(unitType), with repo/site-admin exceptions.
Deadline is processed only when CanWrite(unit.TypeIssues).
PosterID and Poster are bound to ctx.Doer.

rationale: The route-level policy concern is well-founded, but final creation and any downstream authorization were not read; policy should remain undetermined rather than declared violated.
